title: Impeller geometry viewer
line: Turn a shaded 3-D impeller mesh and read its size and surface area.
description: An app that builds a seven-blade centrifugal pump impeller as a triangle mesh and draws it with per-vertex shading. Buttons and sliders set the camera, pop-up menus the finish and light, and a panel lists the diameter, height, wetted area and mesh size.
thumbnailAlt: An app window with a shaded bronze pump impeller beside camera, appearance and part property panels, rendered by RunMat
